articles.title: Coupang Confirms More Data Leaks Which South Korean Aide Says Has ‘Shaken’ US Ties
articles.summary: South Korean e-commerce giant Coupang confirmed a major security breach, revealing the data leak of an additional 165,000 users. This incident highlights the growing cybersecurity challenges faced by global companies and underscores the importance of data protection. The South Korean government is reportedly involved in the ongoing investigation, emphasizing the need for robust digital security measures.

articles.title: py-big-brother added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article outlines an "AI-first" Python code structuring principle mandating "1 file, 1 function." This approach organizes code intuitively, enabling AI agents to easily discern each file's purpose by its name. It promotes modularity, clarity, and efficient project management, crucial for developing robust AI systems and streamlining complex software development processes, vital skills in various technical fields.

articles.title: Jeffs’ Brands: KeepZone AI Enters Into Anti-Submarine and Underwater Security Systems with Strategic Agreement
articles.summary: A Tel Aviv-based global leader in underwater domain awareness has secured an exclusive agreement to support Mexican maritime and offshore security operations. This collaboration will enhance Mexico's ability to monitor its underwater territories effectively. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the critical role of advanced maritime surveillance technologies and international defence partnerships in safeguarding national security and economic zones against evolving threats.

articles.title: UPSC Key: India-Malaysia relations, PM CARES Fund, and AI Impact Summit
articles.summary: This exam syllabus excerpt emphasizes the critical importance of current affairs for SSB aspirants. The Preliminary Examination requires knowledge of national and international developments. For the Mains, General Studies-II specifically covers India's bilateral, regional, and global engagements, including international groupings and agreements. Aspirants must cultivate a comprehensive understanding of India's foreign policy and its role in global affairs.

articles.title: ISRO identifies site for Chandrayaan-4 lander
articles.summary: ISRO has identified a landing site in the Moon's South Polar region for its Chandrayaan-4 mission, expected in two years. The union government has already approved this ambitious lunar exploration project. This initiative underscores India's continuous advancement in space technology and its commitment to scientific research, building upon previous successful lunar missions and demonstrating national capability in space exploration.

articles.title: JMI organises two-day Employability Enhancement Workshop
articles.summary: The new Galaxy F70e 5G smartphone is highlighted for redefining mobile technology specifically for content creators. Described as 'smooth, sharp, and spotlight-ready,' it targets professionals and enthusiasts with advanced features for capturing high-quality media. This launch signifies an advancement in smartphone capabilities, catering to the growing digital content creation market by delivering powerful performance and enhanced user experience.

articles.title: Singapore Airshow 2026 Milestone Edition: 20 Years of Shaping the Aerospace Landscape as Asia-Pacific Drives Global
articles.summary: The Singapore Airshow 2026, organised by Experia Events, is set to take place from February 3-8 at the Changi Exhibition Centre. Marking its 10th edition, this premier international aerospace and defence exhibition will showcase cutting-edge aviation technology, foster industry collaborations, and highlight advancements crucial for global security and economic growth, attracting key players and stakeholders worldwide.
